$comment: Shared copy for tools/build_landing.py. Tokens in {braces} are filled at build time from config/brand.json and config/pricebook.json: {brand}, {price:CODE.setup|monthly|deposit}, {refund}, {days:CODE}, {usage_voice}, {usage_sms}, {overage_pct}, {cancel_days}, {bundle_save_setup}, {bundle_save_monthly}, {quote_sla}, {quote_sla_cap}, {quote_sla_short}, {business_days}, {refund_label}, {guarantee}, {guarantee_label}, {guarantee_body}, {guarantee_days}, {founding_label}, {worked_with}, {assistant} (per page), {disclaimer}, {country}. Never type a brand name or a price here. Markup: **bold**; *word* = the accent word (italic serif on a violet brush stroke), at most one per heading.
worked_with_fallback: Worked with Samsung and Haier in {country} (through their local distributor)

how.title: From first click to *live*. No phone calls.
how.lead: Everything happens in writing, on your schedule. You can stop at any step.

steps.title: Questionnaire
steps.text: Tell us how calls work today, your hours, your service area and your tools. It saves as you go.

steps.title: Fixed quote in writing
steps.text: A fixed price, a clear scope, what is and isn't included. {quote_sla_cap}. Accept it online.

steps.title: Setup checklist with videos
steps.text: Connect your calendar, choose who gets alerts, add your FAQ. Each step has a short video.

steps.title: Live
steps.text: We build and test it, you try it yourself, then you turn on call forwarding. {days:RCP} business days after your access checklist is done.

how.video_call: Prefer a quick 15-min video call? It's optional, never required.

proof.title: Small studio. Fixed prices. Everything in *writing*.

rows.v: Your {assistant} runs on Claude, Anthropic's AI model. We are an independent studio, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
The price on this page is the price on your quote. Add-ons are listed with their prices. No hourly billing.
{quote_sla_cap} of your questionnaire. Business days are {business_days}. Valid for 14 days. No sales calls, ever.

keep_number.q: Do I keep my business number?
keep_number.a: Yes. You set call forwarding on no-answer or busy to the AI line we set up. Calls you pick up never reach it. Our checklist shows how for Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Comcast Business, RingCentral and Google Voice.

cost.a: {price:RCP.setup} setup and {price:RCP.monthly} a month. You pay a {price:RCP.deposit} deposit to start and the rest before go-live. The monthly fee starts on your go-live date. {usage_text}

ai_disclosure.a: Yes. It introduces itself as your virtual assistant and never claims to be a person. The greeting says the call may be transcribed. We keep transcripts, not audio.

no_call.q: Do I have to get on a call with you?
no_call.a: No. You fill in a questionnaire, get a written quote {quote_sla} (business days are {business_days}), and finish a setup checklist with short videos. If you want a 15-minute video call anyway, you can book one. It's optional.

timeline.a: {days:RCP} business days after you finish the access checklist (calendar, alerts, SMS registration details). Rush delivery is available as an add-on.

cancel.q: Can I cancel? What if I'm not happy?
cancel.a: {guarantee} {refund} Monthly service cancels with {cancel_days} days notice.

who.a: A small studio that builds AI tools for local businesses, working remotely from {country}. {worked_with}. Built with Claude; not affiliated with Anthropic.

spanish.a: Yes, as an add-on: {price:ADD-ES.setup} setup + {price:ADD-ES.monthly}/mo. Callers can talk or text in Spanish; your summaries stay in English.

builtin_ai.q: Why not the AI assistant built into Jobber or Housecall Pro?
builtin_ai.a: Built-in assistants are a good fit if you only need booking inside that app. Ours answers the phone itself, works with any calendar or CRM, hands off to a person when needed, and comes with someone who maintains it.

cta_band.title: Get your *fixed* quote. No call needed.

missed.eyebrow: What happens to a missed call
missed.title: The caller doesn't wait. Your *{assistant}* doesn't either.

usage_text_fallback: {usage_voice} minutes + {usage_sms} texts included every month. We alert you at 80%. No surprise charges: extra usage is added only if you approve it.
sms_note: Text-back starts after US carrier registration (A2P 10DLC), typically 1–2 weeks. Voice answering starts right away.

founder.text: {founding_label}: {price:RCP.founding} setup + {price:RCP.monthly}/mo for the first {founding_max} clients, in exchange for a short case study.

after_pay.title: Five steps, with *dates*.
after_pay.lead: Day 0 is the day your deposit arrives. Business days.

steps.title: Welcome + checklist
steps.text: You get a welcome email and your setup checklist in the portal. Each item has a short video.

steps.title: You connect things
steps.text: Calendar, who gets alerts, hours, FAQ, and your business details for SMS registration. About an hour in total.

steps.title: We register your texting
steps.text: We file the US carrier registration (A2P 10DLC) for you. It usually takes 1–2 weeks; fees included.

steps.title: Built and tested
steps.text: We set it up and run it through test conversations. You get a test number and call it yourself.

steps.title: You approve, it goes live
steps.text: You approve go-live, pay the second half, and turn on call forwarding with our step-by-step video.

why.title: Your customers would rather *text*. Most businesses never text back.
why.lead: A missed call is usually followed by a text, or by a call to the next company on the list.
